work_item: B04 ordinary CLI CSV/JSON table conversion follow-up and English header admission correction
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: Explicit table input -> sealed input -> unique Core -> string-preserving CSV/JSON output with exact source/output ranges, downstream actual-output consumption and typed stops
three_document_set: N/A; no construction three-document set specified
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

pre_correction_observation.production_source: Base commit; only the new normal-route assertions had been added.
pre_correction_observation.observed_result: Mixed-case CSV-to-JSON header-mode and JSON-to-CSV headers returned SUSPEND with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE. Japanese/lowercase roundtrip assertions preceding those cases passed. The formula-policy and schema/missing-mode tests passed.
pre_correction_observation.not_reached: The no-header variants in the first test were not reached before its mixed-case header-mode failure; all are observed in the corrected final run.
pre_correction_observation.cause: The coarse document admission guard used case-sensitive starts_with for both conversion commands, while the complete header parsers already used (?i).

correction: Match csv-to-json and json-to-csv prefix admission using (?i), consistent with their existing complete header regexes. Advance parser revision; exact body bytes, header-mode declaration, string values, formula policy, schema and resource bounds remain under their existing contracts.

tests_and_route.route_method: Integration tests launch minidora-rust with --json and fresh real stores. Each subsequent conversion receives the actual previous CLI text as a new explicit request. Returned DocumentResult dependencies are read with actor/case-checked Store::get_bytes, and separate inspect processes verify original requests and complete persisted results. No action or result is synthesized; this is explicit caller-fed composition, not an automatic Core multi-step plan.
tests_and_route.full_workspace_tests: NOT_RUN; scoped bidirectional normal routes, formula/schema stops and affected input/document component tests were run with workspace all-target compile/lint. Earlier full-suite records belong to their own snapshots.

route_observations.observed: COMMIT/COMPUTED for both stages; the canonical fixture returns byte-identical CSV. Headerless mode retains the first row as data and emits columns:null. 001, 9007199254740993, 1e3 and the empty cell remain strings.

route_observations.route: JsonToCsv -> explicit next CsvToJson header-mode request
route_observations.observed: Rows-first field order and an escaped cat lexeme decode correctly. CSV equals the canonical fixture, and parsing the restored JSON equals the original decoded table value; original JSON raw-byte equality is not claimed.

route_observations.route: CsvToJson -> explicit next JsonToCsv request with formula-leading content
route_observations.observed: The first stage COMMITs inert JSON strings without changing values or header text. Export of that actual JSON SUSPENDs with CSV_FORMULA_RISK, UNKNOWN and no result dependencies. Original request bytes and prior successful conversion remain persisted; no spreadsheet process is executed.

cases.input: duplicate decoded headers a and escaped a

span_and_persistence_evidence: Each of the 18 successful fixture conversion stages checks the exact nine unique (kind,row,column) span tuples, raw source start/end and text, decoded string value and actual output start/end. Independent known row fragments locate quoted CRLF, double quotes and empty tokens without matching an unrelated quote pair. Header/no-header row identities, JSON header row:null, full source/output hashes, returned dependency hash, render hash, content-plan equality and fresh-process inspection are checked.

retained_local_evidence.remote_storage_verification: NOT_RUN; local diagnostic-state/log retention only, no OneDrive storage claim

known_limits: These authored cases are scoped QC evidence, not independent held-out B04 acceptance.

Byte-identical CSV roundtrip is observed for this canonical fixture only. General conversion may normalize quoting and final CRLF; decoded value preservation and original source-artifact retention are distinct contracts.
The declared leading-marker guard was exercised locally; no external spreadsheet, formula execution or arbitrary export-policy acceptance was performed.
Broader schema transformations, other structured routes, full workspace runtime regression, external LIVE evaluation, Windows/macOS, physical 8 GB QA, release and deployment are NOT_RUN.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; selected bidirectional conversion, source/output mapping and typed stop routes observed, not the complete B04 contract
